children: Turkey's finance minister said on Friday that the liquidation of investment funds will not cause pressure on Borsa Istanbul and that there is no broad systemic or structural risk due to recent volatility.

Developments in markets were caused by liquidity and credit issues at limited investment funds and around 90% of the investment fund system is operating healthily Simsek said adding that additional measures will be taken in the non-bank finance sector.
